lam_stop.src: Assumption. Qualitative basis: Reinelt 2016 (many CHP stops in 106 days), Korean experience of frequent faults of gas engines / steam users

lam_power.src: KEPCO interruptions per customer 0.08-0.13 per year (2025 statistics, released via a National Assembly office, Segye Ilbo 2026-07-14)

D_dist.src: Assumption. Durations in ARIA 47807 (1.5 h), 49983, 42739 (30 min) as reference

pfd_flare.src: Assumption. Mid value of the IEC 61511 SIL 1 band (0.01-0.1); failure modes (ignition, flame detection, freezing) after Travnicek

lam_foam.src: Kougias 2014 (16 Danish plants, up to 3 per year), Moeller 2012 (7 of 15 plants regularly)

p_block_foam.src: Assumption. EA 2019 incident review (foam blocking PRVs and gas lines)

p_pv_fouled.src: Assumption (v4.1: 0.3 -> 0.1, the same value as the QRA seal-failure chain). EA 2019 (2012-06 foam blocked the PRV and the roof ruptured; 2013-01 floating layer blocked the PRV). Sensitivity 0.03-0.3

lam_freeze.src: Assumption. ARIA 47807 / 42739 (isolation by freezing, frozen valve)

lam_xv.src: Assumption. Shut-off valve mis-operation / interlock isolation (ARIA 49983)

lam_wv.src: Assumption. Weight-loaded lid stuck (corrosion, freezing). ARIA 42739 (frozen relief valve)

R_day.src: Assumption. Attended operation during the day

R_night.src: Assumption. Reinelt 2016: before monitoring the operators were unaware of the releases

demand_series.src: Operating model: 641 flare demands per year

t_retry_h.src: Automatic retry interval after an ignition failure. 0 = no automatic retry (operator response only). 0.5 matches the 1-s model

n_retry.src: Maximum number of automatic retries; if all fail the event passes to the operator response (R)

p_hard.src: Assumption. Share of failures that a retry cannot clear (flame detector, pilot gas, freezing, cf. Travnicek) -> operator response only. Sensitivity value 0.3

pressure_backup.src: Whether a pressure-based flare start (PSH) exists. With fill-level start only, False -> no backup in the stuck-vent-valve branch

level_bias.src: Assumption. Ultrasonic level indicator error (inner membrane shape). Sensitivity: {-0.05: .25, 0: .5, +0.05: .25}

p_pv_stuck.unit: probability of failure per opening demand (one valve)
p_pv_stuck.src: NOG-070 (2020) Table A.2.1, PSV: lambda_DU 1.1e-6 /h (fail to open before test pressure), annual proof test: PFD = lambda tau / 2 = 4.8e-3. Sensitivities: 2.2e-6 /h (all DU modes), dirty service x5 (foam, sulphur, condensate)

beta_pv.src: IEC 61508-6 beta for two identical valves on a shared header (1oo2: PFD = beta PFD + PFD^2); stop / demand / wv branches. Foam / block branches isolate one digester -> one valve

p_reseat.unit: probability of reseat failure per opening episode

Q_leak.src: Assumption. Leak rate after a reseat failure

t_leak_h.src: Assumption. Mean time until a leak is found and fixed
